scientific_integrity: Theorems are proved analytically; the numerical checker supplies finite diagnostics only. Earlier general representer equivalences are credited, not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to two distinct sites on the real line with Laplace kernel and 0<p<1; cannot infer a multi-site sharp constant or optimal sampling design. Earlier equivalent forms may exist.
title: Sharp two-sample quasi-Banach Lebesgue constants and a symmetry-breaking transition for the Laplace kernel
